source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether adolescence includes emotional and behavioural changes in addition to physical changes, and whether recognising emotions can help a person choose thoughtful actions.
node_labels: Living systems: organisms, health and ecosystems

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Stronger emotions by themselves help adolescents make more thoughtful choices.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Stronger adolescent emotions are the result, not a cause, of changes in behaviour.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Excitement does not count as an emotional change of adolescence; only confusing feelings count.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Adolescence involves only physical changes, such as height, hair, and voice changes.

intelligence.enrichment: Adolescence is not only about physical and reproductive changes. It is also marked by emotional and behavioural changes, with stronger emotions than childhood that can affect behaviour and actions; understanding this influence helps people make better choices. stronger adolescent emotions -> effects on behaviour and actions; understanding emotions -> more thoughtful choices The learner applies the idea that adolescence includes emotional and behavioural changes as well as physical changes, and that recognizing emotions can guide thoughtful action. Adolescence is only about body changes, and feelings are separate personal issues.
